messages:
Maria Gonzales: Quick check — I want to promote a staging secret path into the prod overlay for the payments svc. Plan is: add TF mapping, update k8s secretRef from /redwood/staging/payments -> /redwood/prod/payments, and a small kustomize patch. Any gating blockers we should be aware of?

Josh Patel: Are we doing a canary for this? how will replicas pick up rotated secret after switch? :eyes:

Devon Kline: If we're changing the path, make sure the k8s serviceaccount IAM role has access to the new SecretsManager path. Also confirm the KMS key ARN is identical (or that key policy allows access).

Liam O'Connor: Heads up: rotation lambda is currently wired to the old secret name. If we copy/move path we'll either need to rewire or trigger rotation for the new secret. Suggest canary by patching 1 replica first and verifying env + ingress logs.

Anya Rhee: Add one more: update the overlay kustomize patch with the new secretName and include an annotation like `redwood/secret-version` so rollout can detect changes. Also update the release-gate config to add a short manual hold for this change.

infra-bot: tfplan linter: WARNING secret resource uses force_new_on_change for `secret_string`, please confirm this won't cause unintended re-creation. Sample plan snippet follows:

```hcl
# proposed change (excerpt)
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "payments_prod" {
  name       = "/redwood/prod/payments"
  kms_key_id = "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh"
}

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "payments_prod_version" {
  secret_id     = aws_secretsmanager_secret.payments_prod.id
  secret_string = var.payments_secret_payload
}
```

SRE Oncall: +1 on the staged canary approach. Please add a hold window in release-gate for 00:00-06:00 UTC avoidance. Also flag security to review KMS usage and rotation.

Maria Gonzales: Thanks — I'll open a PR with the TF diff and the kustomize overlay patch and tag @Devon Kline and @Liam O'Connor for review. Will include the rotation notes and a short rollback plan. PR WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/5423

Josh Patel: Nice, also add a short note in the release checklist about verifying secret mount and pod env after rollout. :thumbsup:

Maria Gonzales: Created PR and kicked off tfplan, posting plan output when ready. Thanks all for quick sync!
